deployment: validated with GE and Philips TEE systems only
families.summary: Standalone software (version 1.2.0) that reconstructs a 3D model of the left atrial appendage from up to three 2D TEE DICOM videos and outputs automated landing-zone measurements for LAAC pre-procedural planning and device sizing. Cleared June 15, 2026 (K260300) via traditional 510(k) with Circle TruPlan CT (K222593) as predicate; supported by a prospective 6-site U.S. study (NCT07126600, n=100 enrolled, 72 per-protocol) showing non-inferiority and superiority to physician-read 2D TEE for landing-zone maximum diameter against consensus CT.
families.intended_use_quote: The WatchMate Software (Version 1.2.0) is a standalone software application intended for use by healthcare professionals during left atrial appendage closure (LAAC) procedures. It processes transesophageal echocardiography (TEE) images to assist in pre-procedural planning and device sizing.
families.indications_for_use_quote: WatchMate Software enables visualization and measurement of structures of the heart and vessels for pre-procedural planning and sizing for the left atrial appendage closure (LAAC) procedure. To facilitate the above, WatchMate Software provides general functionality such as: • 3D reconstruction of the left atrial appendage (LAA) from trans-esophageal echocardiogram images of the left atrial appendage • Visualization and image reconstruction, including 2D review and 3D rendering • Measurement and annotation tools The results are intended to be used by qualified clinicians in conjunction with the patient's clinical history, symptoms, and other preprocedural evaluations, as well as the clinician's professional judgment. WatchMate Software’s intended patient population is comprised of adult patients.
embedded_ai_features: Video validation models that classify 2D B-mode TEE input and confirm presence of the LAA
Character recognition models extracting transducer angle and imaging depth from each frame
Anatomy segmentation model (LAA, left atrium, left pulmonary vein, cardiac vessels, left ventricle) per TEE frame
3D mesh generation models (densified point cloud from segmentation contours converted to surface mesh)

Landing zone estimation algorithm providing a tentative, user-adjustable landing-zone plane with quantitative measurements (max/min diameters, area/perimeter-based diameters, depth, compression ratios)
Optional device simulation / device placement helper utilities

families.product_name: syngo Dynamics Auto EF / Extended View Classification / Auto Measures (VA40F, VA41D, VA41F)
deployment: client-server on-premise software (hardware not part of device)
families.summary: syngo Dynamics is a multimodality cardiology image management and reporting system. Version VA40F (K222428, 2022-11-14) added an AI/ML semi-automated biplane LVEF tool (Auto EF) for apical 4- and 2-chamber TTE views; VA41D (K242551, 2025-04-03) re-trained the LV contouring model and authorized a PCCP for Auto EF; VA41F (K253689, 2026-04-10) added Auto Measures (8 Doppler/2D measurement groups) and Extended View Classification with PCCPs for all three AI functions. Auto EF standalone testing on 150 studies from 3 U.S. sites gave biplane EF Pearson r 0.827 (VA40F) and 0.822 with bias −0.2% EF (VA41D/VA41F) against two-sonographer manual method-of-disks.
families.intended_use_quote: syngo Dynamics is intended to be used by trained healthcare professionals in a professional healthcare facility to review, edit, and manipulate image data, as well as to generate quantitative data, qualitative data, and diagnostic reports.
families.indications_for_use_quote: syngo Dynamics is a multimodality, vendor agnostic Cardiology image and information system intended for medical image management and processing that provides capabilities relating to the review and digital processing of medical images. syngo Dynamics supports clinicians by providing post image processing functions for image manipulation, and/or quantification that are intended for use in the interpretation and analysis of medical images for disease detection, diagnosis, and/or patient management within the healthcare institution’s network. syngo Dynamics is not intended to be used for display or diagnosis of digital mammography images in the U.S.
embedded_ai_features: Auto EF: semi-automated LV ejection fraction and volumes (biplane method of disks) in apical 4- and 2-chamber views of adult TTE; includes view classification and image-based cardiac phase (ED/ES) detection plus LV auto-contouring; user can review, edit or reject (VA40F onward; contouring model re-trained in VA41D)
Auto Measures: semi-automated measurements for 8 measurement groups in adult TTE — PLAX 2D, MV Inflow, AoV Systolic Flow, LVOT Systolic Flow, MR Flow, MV VTI, PV Systolic Flow, TR Flow (VA41F)
Extended View Classification (EVC): assigns view labels to 2D B-mode TTE clips, including contrast studies, as a workflow aid (VA41F)

training_data.description: Training set sizes are not disclosed in any of the three summaries. K242551 states only that the LV auto contouring algorithm 'has been updated with pre-training and additional annotated training data' and that the algorithm 'is re-trained with more training data'. Test data are stated to be independent of the training data for Auto EF and EVC. Siemens' Auto EF academy page says the tool 'utilizes a database of typical adult transthoracic images' (no size given).
training_data.source: K242551 510(k) summary pages 11 and 13; K222428 page 12; K253689 pages 13-14; Siemens academy Auto EF page

validation_data.description: Auto EF: 150-study standalone test set from 3 U.S. sites (2 regions), gender balanced, age 21–93 (mean 64), BMI 16.5–48.8 (mean 27.9), Philips/GE/Siemens systems, full range of cardiac function; ground truth by 2 independent sonographers (biplane MOD); reused unchanged across VA40F, VA41D and VA41F. Auto Measures (VA41F): 150 images from unique patients per each of 8 measurement groups, 3 U.S. sites, each vendor ≥25%. EVC (VA41F): TTE studies with and without contrast from 3 U.S. sites, age 21–93 (mean 66), BMI 13.5–52.7 (mean 29.5); size not stated. No clinical (in-use) studies were performed for any version.

prior_validations.description: Siemens academy page for Auto EF (VA41A and higher): tool 'is only validated for apical 4 chamber and apical 2 chamber images', 'has not been validated on Doppler images or images containing contrast', and 'has not been validated on horizontally inverted images such as those acquired in pediatric studies or images that have been vertically flipped'.

Siemens USA product page: 'Echocardiography AI: automated measurements and view classification - no additional software launch required' and 'syngo Dynamics enables vendor-agnostic, semi-automated off-cart view classification and routine echo measurements directly within the application.' No performance data on the page.

open_questions: No peer-reviewed publication describing or validating the syngo Dynamics Auto EF, Auto Measures, or Extended View Classification algorithms was found in PubMed (queries on 'syngo Dynamics' + ejection fraction/Auto EF/view classification and Siemens Healthineers affiliation + automated EF returned no relevant records as of 2026-09-05).
Training data size, number of sites, vendors, and demographics are not disclosed for any of the three AI functions.
Discrepancy across summaries: K222428 reports the VA40F biplane EF correlation as 0.827, whereas K242551 restates the predicate (VA40F) value as 0.826.
The K242551 summary cites the predicate once as 'K222482' (page 7) and elsewhere as K222428; treated as a typo for K222428.

Numeric performance results for Auto Measures and EVC (accuracy, agreement, processing success rates) are not in the K253689 summary; they are stated to be in the Instructions for Use, which was not retrieved.
Number of patients (vs studies/images) in the 150-study Auto EF test set and whether the same studies were used for the Auto Measures groups is not stated.
Whether the acceptance-criteria reference K210053 (cited in K222428) is a Siemens or third-party device was not verified in this session.

The 2023 Nature randomized trial of sonographer vs AI EF (He et al., DOI 10.1038/s41586-023-05947-3, resolved via Crossref) used syngo Dynamics VA40D as the reporting workstation but evaluated the EchoNet-Dynamic model, not Siemens Auto EF; it is therefore not listed as a validation of this product.

notes: Both families researched from scratch from the full FDA summary texts plus openFDA, clinicaltrials.gov, PubMed E-utilities, Crossref and company pages. WatchMate (K260300) is the only entry with a prospective external clinical study (NCT07126600, confirmed via clinicaltrials.gov API) and with disclosed training-set sizes (frame/scan counts, not patients); no papers or product page exist yet. Siemens syngo Dynamics: three chronological clearances (VA40F, VA41D, VA41F); category set to comprehensive-measurement because VA41F adds 8 Doppler/2D Auto Measures groups and view classification on top of Auto EF (earlier versions alone would be lv-function-quantification). All Siemens performance numbers come from a single reused 150-study bench test set; training data undisclosed; no peer-reviewed papers found for either family, so papers arrays are empty rather than guessed. Applicant differs across Siemens clearances (Siemens Medical Solutions USA for K222428; Siemens Healthcare GmbH for K242551/K253689) and is recorded in changes_summary.
